item.title: Platform v2 migration maintenance — identified
item.description: Furries PH is performing a planned migration of the Partners dashboard, registration, administration, and Social services to v2. Both V1 and V2 web surfaces are temporarily unavailable. The API remains available. Service is expected to return by 6:00 PM Philippine time.
